description: Your VSCode editor has become extremely slow over the past few weeks. Autocomplete takes 3-5 seconds, file switching is sluggish, and CPU usage is high even when idle. You have a pair programming session tomorrow and need to fix this tonight. TASK: Diagnose and fix the performance issues by: (1) REMOVING the deprecated 'Bracket Pair Colorizer' extension (it has been superseded by native VSCode features), (2) Either DISABLING or OPTIMIZING 'GitLens' extension by turning off expensive features like currentLine blame, codeLens, and annotation hovers (or remove it entirely if you prefer), (3) CONFIGURING performance settings in workspace .vscode/settings.json or user settings to EXCLUDE node_modules, dist, and .git directories from file watchers and search (use settings: files.watcherExclude, search.exclude, files.exclude), (4) CREATE a file named 'PERFORMANCE_NOTES.md' in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/perf_project/) documenting your changes with at least 3 bullet points explaining what extensions you disabled/removed and what settings you changed and why (must mention words 'extension' and 'performance' and be at least 80 characters). The workspace is located at /home/ga/workspace/perf_project/ and contains an INITIAL_SETUP.md file listing current problematic extensions and configuration. Check the Extensions view (Ctrl+Shift+X) to see installed extensions and Settings (Ctrl+,) to modify configurations.
